propositions: Within a single _run_opengrep invocation, semgrep --validate --config must run exactly once per unique detector source_path and the result fanned to all detectors from that source.
A call-local dict[str, RunResult] keyed by source_path is introduced in _run_opengrep with no module-level, persistent, or cross-scan caching state.
Validation failure on a shared source must still quarantine every detector declared from that source as invalid_detector with per-detector detail preserved.
Scan execution, SARIF normalization, output equality, and coverage records remain unchanged; no scanner invocation is removed or mocked in production code.
The measured 11.89s saving (26.025s → 14.135s median, 22 → 10 validation subprocesses) is achieved by eliminating duplicate --validate calls within one _run_opengrep invocation.
Cross-worker scan-result reuse (option b) is filed as a separate idea ticket and kept out of scope due to xdist worker-local fixture limitations and stale-result risk.
